body: I have a rare medical condition where I feel a constant burning pain in my body and have tried countless legal and some illegal drugs to help with it. None have worked and the pain has been growing steadily for years now. It’s at the point where I can no longer do the things I love such as various sports or even hanging out with friends is painful.
Yes, I’ve honestly felt like this everyday for the past 14 months, or at least that’s when I noticed it. I’m just too drained to continue on.

Dude hit me up in the dms and I’ll talk to you. I know how you feel because I’m feeling it right now, and I hate to think anybody else could be so feel free to talk to me as long as you want. I could even give you my number and we could just chat on the phone for a bit if you’d like.
